FULL NAME

Databases & Cloud: PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Docker, AWS (S3, EC2), Git, CI/CD pipelines, RESTful APIs, GraphQL
Methodologies: Agile/Scrum, Test-Driven Development (TDD), System Design, Performance Optimization

• Collaborated cross-functionally with product managers and UX designers across 12 sprint cycles to deliver features ahead of schedule.

Junior Web Developer | Digital Solutions Lab | 2020 - 2022
• Developed and maintained 15+ client web applications using JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, and REST APIs.
• Implemented automated CI/CD deployment workflows, cutting staging release turnaround by 50%.
• Conducted comprehensive code reviews and unit testing, maintaining over 85% test coverage.
